question:
**Choose the most appropriate option to fill the blank in the given sentence.**

Radium ___________ rays that can damage the eyes.
solution:
The correct answer is '**gives off**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**gives off**" means to emit or release, which fits the context of radium emitting rays.
 
• The sentence discusses radium and its ability to emit rays that can damage the eyes, so "**gives off**" is the appropriate choice.
